purpose: Define the complete metadata-only validation universe before target radiance is opened so sessions cannot be added, removed or replaced based on agreement with the model.

acquisitionWindow.definition: intersection of exact instrument calibration validity, operation/configuration validity, product-level type-2 absolute-radiance validity, and availability of the required independent atmosphere/QC metadata
acquisitionWindow.ifMultipleDisjointValidityWindows: freeze each eligible window from metadata and include all eligible twilight sessions in every admitted window

sessionDefinition.sessionIs: one astronomical dawn or dusk transition in which geometric solar depression passes through the frozen [2,10.5] degree interval at the fixed site
sessionDefinition.pgnRoutineOrSequenceId: preserve as metadata and use for pairing/QC, but do not let a product-specific scan identifier split one physical twilight transition into independent statistical sessions

rowAdmissionOrder: bind exact calibration/product/operation validity from metadata
require L1 type-2 absolute-radiance product metadata for the intended source lane
compute geometric Sun depression, target altitude and relative solar azimuth from timestamp/site/true pointing metadata
bind independent AOD550 interval and cloud/glare QC without target radiance
apply exact continuous-AOD Level-B support evaluator across the entire AOD interval
for full three-channel lane apply authoritative s1/s2 pairing, calibration-valid wavelength coverage and single-direction compatibility gates
for s2-only Johnson-V lane require s2 calibration-valid 470-700 nm coverage and s2 true pointing
record admitted/rejected disposition and reason before any target array download

completeUniverseRule.ifMoreThanFortyEligibleSessions: all remain in the frozen universe with equal-session aggregation; do not choose a favorable subset

required: astronomical session ID and dawn/dusk sense
calibration and operation file/version validity identities
true pointing fields and interpreted absolute geometry
independent AOD anchor/bridge source IDs and resulting frozen AOD interval
cloud/glare QC source IDs and disposition
source-lane eligibility and all rejection reasons

objectIntegrity.ifNoPreexistingChecksumIsAvailable: bind immutable provider object identity/URL and metadata header; after separate opening authorization download bytes, hash the untouched file before parsing any target values, and require the hash in the protected-opening record
